capex_override.reason: EWBC's 10-K cash flow statements for FY2023-FY2025 carry no purchases-of-premises-and-equipment line at all (verified in the FY2025 10-K, accession 0001069157-26-000009: premises capex is folded into 'Other investing activities, net'); the us-gaap tag is filed only in 10-Qs from 2025 onward. Premises & equipment net is $82.3M on an $80.4B balance sheet - capex is structurally immaterial for this bank. $14M/yr sits at the top of the filed FY2016-2021 range and ~2.3x the last filed value (inside the 0.1x-10x band), moving base OE by ~1%.
capex_override.source: Last engine-filed capex FY2021 $6,017,000 (10-K, PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment); filed range FY2016-2021 $2.66M-$13.79M per financials_history.csv

moat_against: CRE concentration in the loan book
Niche concentration: one cross-border corridor, exposed to US-China tension and Chinese capital controls
Rate-sensitive NII; regional-bank funding moat thinner than a money-center's
Long-tenured CEO Dominic Ng is a succession question
moat_for: Leading US bank for US-Asia cross-border business - relationships and trade-finance know-how rivals don't replicate
Low-cost relationship deposit franchise (noninterest-bearing deposits +19% YoY Q2 2026; deposits a record $70.1B)
Elite efficiency (36.7%) and NIM (3.43%) for a regional
Fortress capital: CET1 15.4%, tangible common equity 10.4%
Disciplined credit through cycles (Q2 2026 net charge-offs 19bp, NPAs 29bp)
moat_justification: A dominant, decades-deep position in US-Asia cross-border banking with elite through-cycle returns (ROE 10.8%-18.8% FY2016-2025, ~15-17% in recent years, ROTCE 17% in Q2 2026), capped at 6 by CRE concentration and a single-niche franchise directly exposed to US-China friction.
name: East West Bancorp, Inc.
one_liner: Elite-quality regional bank, moat 6/10 - ~15% ROE through a decade and a real cross-border niche, but at $126.47 it doesn't clear the 15% hurdle on normalized earnings (weighted IRR 12.1%, IV@15% $96.22; clears 15% only at ~$96).
